proposition: The only date in the entry for Sharḥ-i Dah Bayt is the Majlis copy date of 18 Ramaḍān 838 (17 April 1435), three years after Melvin-Koushki's date for Ibn Turka's death (835/1432), so it is a posthumous copy and gives no composition date.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
mediation.note: posthumous by the dissertation's own death date
